summary: Isaiah prophesied that a great light would shine on people in darkness, and that a child would be born who would be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. About 700 years later, Jesus was born.

story_reel.narration: God gave Isaiah amazing messages about the future. Some of them were about a special baby who would be born many years later. Isaiah said, 'The virgin will have a son, and she will call His name Immanuel,' which means 'God with us.' Then Isaiah said, 'The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. For those living in the land of deep shadow, a light has shined!' And then Isaiah gave one of the most famous promises in the whole Bible: 'For a child is born to us. A son is given to us. The government will be on His shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. His kingdom will keep growing, and there will be no end to His peace. He will sit on the throne of David forever.' Who was Isaiah talking about? Jesus! But here's the amazing thing: Isaiah wrote these words about seven hundred years before Jesus was born. That's a really long time to wait for a promise! People waited and waited and waited. Some probably wondered if it would ever happen. But God always keeps His promises, right on time. When you have to wait for something, remember: God is never late.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can wait patiently, because Yahweh always keeps His promises right on time.

micro_prayer.text: Jesus, You are the Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace. Help me wait patiently for Your promises, knowing You're never late. Amen.

companion.message: In my day, my people were still waiting for this promised King. We held on to Isaiah's words like treasure. And Jesus came, right on time!
